entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.

entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.

entries.english_reference: It's fine, fine.\nNo need to say a word.

entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Tudo bem, tudo bem.\nNão precisa dizer nada.

entries.english_reference: It's fine, fine.\nYou tried your best, I know.

entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.

entries.english_reference: Hmm"<0xFB>So, you're good, huh?

entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Hum...<0xFB>Então você manda bem, hein?

entries.english_reference: Hmm"<0xFB>So, you are good.\nHmm"

entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Hum...<0xFB>Então você manda bem.\nHum...

entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Hum...<0xFB>Você não é tudo isso. Hum?

entries.english_reference: Let us paint a picture to last an\neternity!
entries.comparison_fr: Peignons une scène pour\nl'éternité !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Vamos pintar um quadro\nque dure uma eternidade!

entries.english_reference: Perhaps I should stick to painting\nlandscapes"
entries.comparison_fr: Peut-être que je devrais rester aux\npaysages…
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Talvez eu devesse pintar\napenas paisagens...

entries.english_reference: The colors of your Pokémon are\ndull.
entries.comparison_fr: Les couleurs de tes Pokémon sont\nternes.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: As cores dos seus Pokémon\nsão sem graça.

entries.english_reference: Hmmm" hold still right there!\nI must paint that powerful pose!
entries.comparison_fr: Hmmm… ne bouge plus !\nJe dois peindre cette pose forte !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Hum... Fique aí, sem se mexer!\nPreciso pintar essa pose forte!

entries.english_reference: What a brilliant display! I would\nlove to paint your Pokémon.
entries.comparison_fr: Quelle démonstration brillante !\nJe veux peindre tes Pokémon.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Que exibição brilhante! Quero\nmuito pintar seus Pokémon.

entries.english_reference: Oh, my dears! Your vivid colors\nhave shone through!

entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Ah, meus queridos! Suas cores\nvibrantes se destacaram!

entries.english_reference: Art isn't my only talent!
entries.comparison_fr: L'art n'est pas mon seul talent !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Arte não é meu único talento!

entries.english_reference: Aargh! I got some paint in\nmy eyes!
entries.comparison_fr: Aargh ! J'ai de la peinture dans\nles yeux !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Argh! Caiu tinta\nnos meus olhos!

entries.english_reference: I guess a style change from city\nskylines to battles was warranted!
entries.comparison_fr: Changer des villes aux combats,\nc'était le bon style !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Trocar paisagens urbanas por\nbatalhas foi uma boa ideia!

entries.english_reference: May I take your order, please?
entries.comparison_fr: Puis-je prendre votre commande ?
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Posso anotar seu pedido?

entries.english_reference: Ah, an excellent choice.\nA win served fresh.
entries.comparison_fr: Ah, excellent choix.\nUne victoire servie fraîche.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Ah, excelente escolha.\nUma vitória fresquinha.

entries.english_reference: Ah, a fine choice.\nOne loss served fresh.
entries.comparison_fr: Ah, beau choix.\nUne défaite servie fraîche.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Ah, bela escolha.\nUma derrota fresquinha.

entries.english_reference: For battles and order taking,\nspeed is essential!
entries.comparison_fr: Pour servir et combattre,\nla vitesse est essentielle !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Nas batalhas e nos pedidos,\nrapidez é essencial!

entries.english_reference: Food is like battling.\nServe it while it's hot!
entries.comparison_fr: La cuisine, c'est comme le combat.\nServez chaud !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Comida é como batalha.\nSirva enquanto está quente!

entries.english_reference: Like, chop-chop!\nYou got served.
entries.comparison_fr: Allez, plus vite !\nCommandé et servi.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Vamos, rapidinho!\nSeu prato foi servido.

entries.english_reference: Ah, welcome!\nI'm your server today!
entries.comparison_fr: Ah, bienvenue !\nJe suis votre serveur !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Ah, boas-vindas!\nVou atender você hoje!

entries.english_reference: Thank you so much!
entries.comparison_fr: Merci beaucoup !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Muito obrigado!

entries.english_reference: Would you care to settle your\nbill?
entries.comparison_fr: Vous réglez l'addition ?\n
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Gostaria de pagar\na conta?

entries.english_reference: My job is about serving others.\nBut don't expect me to serve here.
entries.comparison_fr: Mon travail sert les autres.\nMais pas question de servir ici.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Meu trabalho é servir. Mas\nnão espere que eu sirva aqui.

entries.english_reference: Why couldn't you serve me?\nYou won't make friends that way!
entries.comparison_fr: Pourquoi tu ne m'as pas servi ?\nTu te feras pas d'amis !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Por que não me serviu?\nAssim não se faz amigos!

entries.english_reference: How may I serve you?
entries.comparison_fr: Comment puis-je vous servir ?
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Como posso servir você?

entries.english_reference: What I really hoped to become was\na cook.
entries.comparison_fr: En fait, je voulais devenir chef.\n
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: O que eu queria mesmo era\ntrabalhar na cozinha.

entries.english_reference: I just find it hard talking to\nstrangers.
entries.comparison_fr: J'ai du mal à parler aux inconnus.\n
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Só tenho dificuldade em\nfalar com desconhecidos.

entries.english_reference: I don't mind this job now, mind\nyou.
entries.comparison_fr: Ce boulot ne me dérange plus,\nsache-le.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Hoje até que gosto\ndeste trabalho, sabe.

entries.english_reference: I love cute customers like you!\nI'll serve you right!
entries.comparison_fr: J'adore les clients mignons comme\ntoi ! Je te servirai bien !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Adoro clientes fofos assim!\nVou atender você muito bem!

entries.english_reference: Oh, but" I'm not done serving\nyou.
entries.comparison_fr: Oh, mais… Je n'ai pas fini de\nte servir.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Ah, mas... Ainda não\nterminei de servir você.

entries.english_reference: Well, were you happy with the way\nI served you?
entries.comparison_fr: Alors, satisfait de mon service ?\n
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: E aí, gostou da forma\ncomo eu servi você?

entries.english_reference: You can shake hands with me!<0xFB>It would be quite the honour for\nyou!
entries.comparison_fr: Tu peux me serrer la main !\pQuel honneur pour toi !\n
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Pode apertar minha mão!<0xFB>Seria uma grande honra\npara você!

entries.english_reference: My management team will have\nsomething to say about this!
entries.comparison_fr: Mon équipe de gestion va avoir\nun mot à dire !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Minha equipe de empresários\nvai ter algo a dizer disso!

entries.english_reference: If you'd won, I would have even\ngiven you my autograph!
entries.comparison_fr: Si tu avais gagné, je t'aurais même\ndonné un autographe !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Se tivesse vencido, eu até\nteria dado meu autógrafo!

entries.english_reference: Thanks for supporting me!
entries.comparison_fr: Merci de me soutenir !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Valeu pelo apoio!

entries.english_reference: What a horrible way to treat an\nidol"
entries.comparison_fr: Quel horrible traitement pour une\nidole…
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Que jeito horrível de\ntratar um ídolo...

entries.english_reference: Oh? You're not my fan?
entries.comparison_fr: Oh ? Tu n'es pas mon fan ?
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Ah? Você não é meu fã?

entries.english_reference: Watch me! All eyes on me!
entries.comparison_fr: Regarde-moi ! Tous les yeux sur moi
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Olhe para mim! Todos olhando!

entries.english_reference: I became an idol because I wanted\neveryone to see me!
entries.comparison_fr: Je suis devenue idole pour que\ntout le monde me voie !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Virei ídolo porque queria\nque todos me vissem!

entries.english_reference: Ooh" This is what I live for"
entries.comparison_fr: Ooh… C'est ça que je vis…
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Ah... É para isso que vivo...

entries.english_reference: A battle, you say?\nI'm never losing to you!
entries.comparison_fr: Un combat, tu dis ?\nJe ne perdrai jamais contre toi !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Uma batalha, é?\nNunca vou perder para você!

entries.english_reference: Urk" We lost"
entries.comparison_fr: Urk… On a perdu…
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Argh... Perdemos...

entries.english_reference: Yeehah! Yippee!\nI won, I won!
entries.comparison_fr: Yeehah ! Youpi !\nJ'ai gagné, j'ai gagné !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Ihu! Oba!\nGanhei, ganhei!

entries.english_reference: Kneel down before me!
entries.comparison_fr: Agenouille-toi devant moi !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Ajoelhe-se diante de mim!

entries.english_reference: My mommy always says that to my\ndaddy!
entries.comparison_fr: Maman dit toujours ça à papa !\n
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Minha mamãe sempre diz\nisso para o meu papai!

entries.english_reference: Hee hee hee.\nJust what I wanted!
entries.comparison_fr: Hihihi.\nExactement ce que je voulais !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Hehehe.\nEra o que eu queria!

entries.english_reference: My Pokémon are cute,\nbut they're not very tough!
entries.comparison_fr: Mes Pokémon sont mignons,\nmais pas très forts !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Meus Pokémon são fofos,\nmas não são muito fortes!

entries.english_reference: It's OK. I like my Pokémon.\nThat's all that matters.
entries.comparison_fr: Ça va. J'aime mes Pokémon.\nC'est tout ce qui compte.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Tudo bem. Gosto dos meus\nPokémon. É o que importa.

entries.english_reference: Oh? We won? Seriously?
entries.comparison_fr: Oh ? On a gagné ? Sérieux ?
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Ah? Nós ganhamos? Sério?

entries.english_reference: Ready, start!
entries.comparison_fr: Prêt, partez !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Preparar, vai!

entries.english_reference: Waah! Wait for me!
entries.comparison_fr: Waaah ! Attends-moi !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Ei! Espere por mim!

entries.english_reference: First across the finish line!
entries.comparison_fr: Première à la ligne !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Primeiro na linha de chegada!

entries.english_reference: I run a marathon every morning!\nIt's great!
entries.comparison_fr: Je cours un marathon chaque matin !\nC'est génial !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Corro uma maratona toda manhã!\nÉ ótimo!

entries.english_reference: So I lost! I can still run great\nmarathons!
entries.comparison_fr: J'ai perdu ! Je cours quand même\nd'excellents marathons !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Perdi! Mas ainda posso\ncorrer ótimas maratonas!

entries.english_reference: My buff physique makes for easy\nwins!
entries.comparison_fr: Corps musclé,\nvictoires faciles !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Meu físico musculoso\ngarante vitórias fáceis!

entries.english_reference: I'll run on the spot while battling\nfor the good of my health.
entries.comparison_fr: Je cours sur place pendant le\ncombat pour ma santé.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Vou correr sem sair do lugar\nna batalha. Faz bem à saúde.

entries.english_reference: Gasp! My ankle!\nI rolled my ankle!
entries.comparison_fr: Hah ! Ma cheville !\nJe me suis tordu la cheville !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Argh! Meu tornozelo!\nTorci o tornozelo!

entries.english_reference: Run! Faster!
entries.comparison_fr: Cours ! Plus vite !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Corra! Mais rápido!

entries.english_reference: Little boy? Little girl?\nDoesn't matter which.<0xFB>Let's do this!
entries.comparison_fr: Garçon ? Fille ?\nPeu importe.\pAllons-y !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Menino? Menina?\nTanto faz.<0xFB>Vamos nessa!

entries.english_reference: Little boy? Little girl?<0xFB>Doesn't matter which, but you're\nsure tough!
entries.comparison_fr: Garçon ? Fille ?\pPeu importe, mais tu es costaud !\n
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Menino? Menina?<0xFB>Tanto faz, mas você\né forte mesmo!

entries.english_reference: Little boy? Little girl?\nDoesn't matter which, but sorry.
entries.comparison_fr: Garçon ? Fille ?\nPeu importe, mais désolé.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Menino? Menina?\nTanto faz, mas sinto muito.

entries.english_reference: All right, take a run at me!\nMy barrel chest can take it!
entries.comparison_fr: Allez, cours sur moi !\nMon torse peut encaisser !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Certo, venha para cima!\nMeu peitoral aguenta!

entries.english_reference: Ooh" Ow" That hurt"<0xFB>It's like you broke my barrel\nchest"
entries.comparison_fr: Ooh… Aïe… Ça fait mal…\pOn dirait que tu m'as brisé le\npoitrail…
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Ah... Ai... Isso doeu...<0xFB>Parece que você quebrou\nmeu peitoral...

entries.english_reference: What? That's all you've got?\nYou can take a harder run at me!
entries.comparison_fr: Quoi ? C'est tout ?\nTu peux frapper plus fort !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Quê? Só isso? Pode vir\ncom mais força para cima!

entries.english_reference: My favorite drink is Moomoo Milk.\nGot some?
entries.comparison_fr: Ma boisson préférée, c'est Lait\nMeumeu. T'en as ?
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Minha bebida favorita é\nMoomoo Milk. Tem um pouco?

entries.english_reference: Gwaah! Moomoo Milk!\nBring me some Moomoo Milk!
entries.comparison_fr: Gwaah ! Lait Meumeu !\nApporte-moi du Lait Meumeu !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Aaah! Moomoo Milk!\nMe traga Moomoo Milk!

entries.english_reference: Wahaha! I get the win!\nLet's celebrate over some milk!
entries.comparison_fr: Wahaha ! La victoire pour moi !\nFêtons ça au lait !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Hahaha! Eu ganhei! Vamos\ncomemorar com um leite!

entries.english_reference: Do your best! My beloved children!
entries.comparison_fr: Faites de votre mieux, enfants !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Deem seu melhor!\nMeus amados filhos!

entries.english_reference: My Pokémon are my beloved family.
entries.comparison_fr: Mes Pokémon sont ma famille adorée.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Meus Pokémon são\nminha amada família.

entries.english_reference: Wahaha! Well done!\nMama's proud of you!
entries.comparison_fr: Wahaha ! Bien joué !\nMaman est fière de vous !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Hahaha! Muito bem!\nA mamãe se orgulha de vocês!

entries.english_reference: I'm not getting any younger.\nI can't overexert myself.
entries.comparison_fr: Je ne rajeunis pas.\nJe dois ménager mes forces.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Já não sou tão jovem.\nNão posso me esforçar demais.

entries.english_reference: Oh, you're good and young.\nThere's a sparkle about you.
entries.comparison_fr: Oh, tu es jeune et bon.\nTu as une étincelle.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Ah, você é jovem e tem jeito.\nHá um brilho em você.

entries.english_reference: What I lack in youth, I make up\nfor in experience.
entries.comparison_fr: Ce que je n'ai plus en jeunesse,\nje l'ai en expérience.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Compenso a falta de juventude\ncom minha experiência.

entries.english_reference: Smell that?<0xFB>That's the smell of hay clinging\nto my body.
entries.comparison_fr: Tu sens ?\pC'est l'odeur du foin collée à\nmoi.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Sentiu esse cheiro?<0xFB>É o cheiro de feno\ngrudado no meu corpo.

entries.english_reference: This smell I have is the sweet\nscent of hay that Pokémon surely<0xFA>love.
entries.comparison_fr: Cette odeur, c'est le doux parfum\ndu foin que les Pokémon\ladorent.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Meu cheiro é o doce aroma\nde feno que os Pokémon<0xFA>certamente adoram.

entries.english_reference: Whoa!
entries.comparison_fr: Woh !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Opa!

entries.english_reference: I won't lose to a child like you\nwho knows nothing of battles.
entries.comparison_fr: Je ne perdrai pas contre un enfant\nqui ignore tout du combat.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Não vou perder para quem\nnão entende nada de batalhas.

entries.english_reference: What? This child is a fast learner?\nHa ha ha" I had no idea!
entries.comparison_fr: Quoi ? Cet enfant apprend vite ?\nHa ha ha… Je ne savais pas !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Quê? Essa criança aprende\nrápido? Hahaha... Nem sabia!

entries.english_reference: After all, you are an amateur.\nNo sweat.<0xFB>(Whew" That was a little too\nclose!)
entries.comparison_fr: Tu es amateur, après tout.\nPas grave.\p(Ouf… C'était un peu trop juste !)\n
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Afinal, você é amador.\nFoi moleza.<0xFB>(Ufa... Essa foi\npor pouco!)

entries.english_reference: Argh. Cough, cough.\nI don't feel well.<0xFB>Please show a little kindness.
entries.comparison_fr: Argh. Tousse, tousse. Je vais mal.\nUn peu de gentillesse,\ps'il te plaît.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Argh. Cof, cof.\nNão estou bem.<0xFB>Tenha um pouco de bondade.

entries.english_reference: You are very sharp! You did not\nfall for my illness act.
entries.comparison_fr: Tu es vif ! Tu n'as pas cru à\nma maladie.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Você é muito esperto!\nNão caiu no meu fingimento.

entries.english_reference: I lied when I said I did not feel\nwell! Experts do anything to win!
entries.comparison_fr: J'ai menti en disant aller mal !\nLes Pros font tout pour gagner !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Menti sobre passar mal!\nExperts fazem tudo para vencer!

entries.english_reference: I will give you a taste of an\nExpert's well-trained Pokémon.
entries.comparison_fr: Goûte aux Pokémon bien entraînés\nd'un Expert.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Vai provar a força dos\nPokémon bem treinados de Expert.

entries.english_reference: You have served me a spicy defeat.<0xFB>And yet defeat is also part of\nlife.
entries.comparison_fr: Tu m'as servi une défaite épicée.\pLa défaite fait partie de la vie.\n
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Você me serviu uma\nderrota apimentada.<0xFB>Mas a derrota também\nfaz parte da vida.

entries.english_reference: How were the Expert's Pokémon?\nDefeat is bitter, isn't it?
entries.comparison_fr: Alors, les Pokémon de l'Expert ?\nLa défaite est amère, hein ?
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: O que achou dos Pokémon\nde Expert? Perder é amargo, né?

entries.english_reference: Oh, you are so cute!<0xFB>Come, I promise to be nice in\nthis battle.
entries.comparison_fr: Oh, tu es si mignon !\pViens, je serai gentille en combat.\n
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Ah, você é tão fofo!<0xFB>Venha, prometo pegar leve\nnesta batalha.

entries.english_reference: Your battle is a little too cute.\nLet's play again sometime.
entries.comparison_fr: Ton combat est un peu trop mignon.\nOn rejoue bientôt.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Sua batalha é bem fofinha.\nVamos brincar outra hora.

entries.english_reference: You are so cute, really"<0xFB>I want to see you again.\nI'll be waiting.
entries.comparison_fr: Tu es si mignon, vraiment…\pJe veux te revoir.\nJe t'attendrai.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Você é tão fofo, de verdade...<0xFB>Quero ver você de novo.\nVou esperar.

entries.english_reference: Oh, you are still a child.\nWho said you could come here?
entries.comparison_fr: Oh, tu es encore un enfant.\nQui t'a laissé entrer ici ?
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Ah, você ainda é criança.\nQuem deixou você vir aqui?

entries.english_reference: I thought you were a child.\nHee hee" You are tough"
entries.comparison_fr: Je te prenais pour un enfant.\nHihi… Tu es fort…
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Achei que fosse uma criança.\nHehe... Você é forte...

entries.english_reference: You're not bad, but you're\nimmature.<0xFB>Come back when you've learned\nsomething.
entries.comparison_fr: Pas mal, mais immature.\nReviens quand tu auras appris.\p\n
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Você tem jeito, mas\nainda é imaturo.<0xFB>Volte quando tiver\naprendido alguma coisa.

entries.english_reference: Don't call me decrepit!\nA woman's mind is always blooming.
entries.comparison_fr: Ne me traite pas de décrépite !\nL'esprit d'une femme fleurit.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Não me chame de decrépita!\nA mente da mulher floresce sempre.

entries.english_reference: I have pains in my eyes, my\nshoulder, and my back, but my<0xFA>heart is forever young.
entries.comparison_fr: J'ai mal aux yeux, à l'épaule, au\ndos, mais le\lcœur reste jeune.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Meus olhos, ombros e costas\ndoem, mas meu coração<0xFA>é jovem para sempre.

entries.english_reference: I'm not finished with love or\nPokémon.<0xFB>I'll stay fit and ready all my\nlife.
entries.comparison_fr: Je n'en ai pas fini avec l'amour\nni les Pokémon.\pJe resterai en forme toute ma vie.\n
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Não desisti do amor\nnem dos Pokémon.<0xFB>Vou manter a forma\na vida toda.

entries.english_reference: Join the Pokéfans.\nYour life will be happy!
entries.comparison_fr: Rejoins les Pokéfans.\nTu seras heureux !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Junte-se aos Pokéfans.\nSua vida será feliz!

entries.english_reference: If you join the Pokéfans, your\nlife will be saved!
entries.comparison_fr: Si tu rejoins les Pokéfans, ta\nvie sera sauvée !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Junte-se aos Pokéfans e\nsua vida será salva!

entries.english_reference: If you join the Pokéfans, you will\nbe strong like me!
entries.comparison_fr: Si tu rejoins les Pokéfans, tu\nseras fort comme moi !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Junte-se aos Pokéfans e\nserá forte como eu!

entries.english_reference: I am not a regular Pokéfan.\nI am a major mega-Pokéfan!
entries.comparison_fr: Je ne suis pas un simple Pokéfan.\nJe suis un méga Pokéfan !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Não sou um Pokéfan comum.\nSou um grande mega-Pokéfan!

entries.english_reference: You'll remember this!\nI am a big Pokéfan!
entries.comparison_fr: Tu t'en souviendras !\nJe suis un grand Pokéfan !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Você vai se lembrar disso!\nSou um grande Pokéfan!

entries.english_reference: I love Pokémon!\nI love love Pokémon!
entries.comparison_fr: J'aime les Pokémon !\nJ'adore adorer les Pokémon !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Eu amo Pokémon!\nEu amo, amo Pokémon!

entries.english_reference: I think I am a Pokéfan, therefore\nI am a Pokéfan.
entries.comparison_fr: Je pense être un Pokéfan, donc je\nsuis un Pokéfan.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Penso que sou um Pokéfan,\nlogo sou um Pokéfan.

entries.english_reference: You should remember this.\nI am a Pokéfan.
entries.comparison_fr: Souviens-toi de ça.\nJe suis un Pokéfan.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Lembre-se disto.\nSou um Pokéfan.

entries.english_reference: The Pokéfan is power.
entries.comparison_fr: Le Pokéfan, c'est la force.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: O Pokéfan é poder.

entries.english_reference: I took this job because I wanted to\nbe needed by someone.
entries.comparison_fr: J'ai pris ce job pour être utile à\nquelqu'un.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Aceitei este trabalho para\nque alguém precisasse de mim.

entries.english_reference: When a patient leaves the hospital,\nI feel happy but a bit sad.
entries.comparison_fr: Quand un patient sort, je suis\njoyeux mais un peu triste.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Quando um paciente tem alta,\nfico feliz, mas um pouco triste.

entries.english_reference: My job is hard, but I am happy to\nhelp people.
entries.comparison_fr: Mon travail est dur, mais aider les\ngens me rend heureux.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Meu trabalho é difícil, mas\nfico feliz em ajudar as pessoas.

entries.english_reference: Grown-ups have a lot of hobbies.\nActually, I am a uniform collector.
entries.comparison_fr: Les adultes ont plein de hobbies.\nMoi, je collectionne les uniformes.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Adultos têm muitos passatempos.\nEu coleciono uniformes.

entries.english_reference: You realized that I am a fake\nNurse!<0xFB>Yes, I am just a uniform collector.
entries.comparison_fr: Tu vois : faux Infirmier !\nJe collectionne les\puniformes.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Você percebeu que eu não\nsou uma Nurse de verdade!<0xFB>Sim, só coleciono uniformes.

entries.english_reference: I am not a Nurse.\nI wear this uniform just for fun.
entries.comparison_fr: Je ne suis pas Infirmier.\nJe porte cet uniforme pour le fun.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Não sou uma Nurse. Uso este\nuniforme só por diversão.

entries.english_reference: Even if you are injured, I will\ntreat you.<0xFB>So let's fight hard.
entries.comparison_fr: Même blessé, je te soignerai.\nToujours.\pAlors battons-nous à fond.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Mesmo se você se ferir,\nvou cuidar de você.<0xFB>Então vamos lutar com tudo.

entries.english_reference: You went too far! I will bill you\nthe cost of my medical expenses!
entries.comparison_fr: Tu es allé trop loin ! Je te\nfacturerai mes frais médicaux !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Você foi longe demais! Vou\ncobrar meus gastos médicos!

entries.english_reference: Sorry! I went too far. Do you\nrequire immediate hospitalization?
entries.comparison_fr: Pardon ! Je suis allé trop loin.\nBesoin d'hospitalisation urgente ?
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Foi mal! Fui longe demais.\nPrecisa de internação urgente?

entries.english_reference: Amazing!\nAgainst all odds, you triumphed!
entries.comparison_fr: Incroyable !\nContre toute attente, tu as gagné !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Incrível! Contra todas\nas chances, você triunfou!

entries.english_reference: Ah, pity!<0xFB>Tighten your bonds, and come\nchallenge me again!
entries.comparison_fr: Ah, dommage !\pRenforce tes liens et reviens\nme voir !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Ah, que pena!<0xFB>Fortaleça seus laços\ne volte a me desafiar!

entries.english_reference: Huh, how about that.<0xFB>Guess you do know what you're doing\nafter all.
entries.comparison_fr: Eh bien, comment dire.\pTu sais te battre,\nfinalement.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Ora, veja só.<0xFB>Parece que você sabe\no que está fazendo, afinal.

entries.english_reference: How boring"<0xFB>Listen up, kid!\nAnd listen up well!<0xFB>You need a team that can handle\nitself in any situation!<0xFB>Keep that in mind for next time!
entries.comparison_fr: Quelle lassitude…\pÉcoute, gamin !\nÉcoute bien !\pIl te faut une équipe prête à tout !\nDans toute situation !\pSouviens-t'en pour la suite !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Que tédio...<0xFB>Escute aqui, criança!\nE escute bem!<0xFB>Você precisa de uma equipe\npronta para qualquer situação!<0xFB>Lembre disso na próxima vez!

entries.english_reference: Bravo! Bravo! Wonderful!\nYou're a true rising star!
entries.comparison_fr: Bravo ! Bravo ! Formidable !\nTu es une vraie étoile montante !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Bravo! Bravo! Maravilhoso!\nVocê é uma estrela em ascensão!

entries.english_reference: Ah, too bad!<0xFB>Ladies and gentlemen, boys and\ngirls, I hope you enjoyed the show!
entries.comparison_fr: Ah, dommage !\pMesdames, messieurs, j'espère que\nle show vous a plu !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Ah, que pena!<0xFB>Senhoras, senhores e crianças,\nespero que curtiram o show!

entries.english_reference: Hey, there!<0xFB>I'm Skeli, one of the developers of\nPokémon Unbound.<0xFB>I'm glad you took the time to come\nbattle here!<0xFB>Now, let's have a fun time!
entries.comparison_fr: Hé, salut !\pMoi, c'est Skeli, un des devs de\nPokémon Unbound.\pMerci d'être venu\nte battre ici !\pAllez, amusons-nous !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Oi!<0xFB>Sou Skeli, um dos criadores\nde Pokémon Unbound.<0xFB>Que bom que tirou um tempo\npara vir batalhar aqui!<0xFB>Agora, vamos nos divertir!

entries.english_reference: Alright!\nThat was fun!
entries.comparison_fr: Génial !\nC'était fun !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Muito bem!\nFoi divertido!

entries.english_reference: I'm looking forward to battling you\nagain in the future!
entries.comparison_fr: J'ai hâte de te rebattre\nbientôt !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Espero batalhar de novo\ncom você no futuro!

Hey, there!
I'm Golche!<0xFB>The strategies of the Trainers you
faced?<0xFB>I helped make them!<0xFB>Let's see what you can do against
my strategy!
entries.comparison_fr:

Moi, c'est Golche !\pLes stratégies des Dresseurs que tu

strat !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.

Oi!
Sou Golche!<0xFB>As estratégias dos Treinadores
que você enfrentou?<0xFB>Ajudei a criá-las!<0xFB>Vamos ver como você se sai
contra minha estratégia!

entries.english_reference: Hmm"<0xFB>Looks like I've got some refining\nto do"
entries.comparison_fr: Hmm…\pFaut encore peaufiner, on dirait…\n
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Hum...<0xFB>Parece que ainda tenho\no que aperfeiçoar...

entries.english_reference: What a fun battle!<0xFB>I look forward to battling you\nagain with some new tricks!
entries.comparison_fr: Quel bon combat !\pHâte de te revoir avec de\nnouvelles astuces !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Que batalha divertida!<0xFB>Quero batalhar com você\nde novo, com novos truques!

entries.english_reference: Don't think it'll be easy to beat\nme!<0xFB>You're facing the legacy Pokémon\nTrainer" Thanasis!
entries.comparison_fr: Ne crois pas me battre\nsi facilement !\pTu affrontes le Dresseur\nlégendaire… Thanasis !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Não pense que vai ser fácil\nme derrotar!<0xFB>Você enfrenta o lendário\nTreinador Pokémon... Thanasis!

entries.english_reference: I have to admit, you really are\nsomething special.
entries.comparison_fr: Je dois l'admettre, tu es vraiment\nspécial.
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Admito que você é mesmo\nalguém especial.

entries.english_reference: It seems you're not ready to face\nme just yet!
entries.comparison_fr: On dirait que tu n'es pas encore\nprêt pour moi !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Parece que você ainda não\nestá pronto para me enfrentar!

animations!

E aí?
Sou Lixdel!<0xFB>Criei boa parte das belas

uma enxurrada delas!

entries.english_reference: That battle was almost as beautiful\nas the animations!
entries.comparison_fr: Ce combat était presque aussi beau\nque les animations !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Essa batalha foi quase tão\nbela quanto as animações!

entries.english_reference: Nice!<0xFB>That battle was close to being as\nbeautiful as the animations!

entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Legal!<0xFB>Essa batalha chegou perto\nda beleza das animações!

entries.english_reference: I, Cynthia, accept your challenge!\nThere won't be any letup from me!

entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Eu, Cynthia, aceito seu desafio!\nNão vou dar trégua!

entries.english_reference: No matter how fun the battle is, it\nwill always end sometime"

entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Por mais divertida que seja,\ntoda batalha acaba um dia...

entries.english_reference: Even if you lose, never lose your\nlove of Pokémon.

entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
entries.portuguese: Mesmo perdendo, nunca perca\nseu amor pelos Pokémon.

entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.

entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.

entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.

entries.english_reference: Whoa, ya sure showed me how to\nbattle! Ha ha ha!
entries.comparison_fr: Whoa, tu m'as montré comment\ncombattre ! Ha ha ha !
entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.

entries.english_reference: And you weren't even at any\ndisadvantage! Ha ha ha!

entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.

entries.english_reference: You're mighty!\nYou're worthy of lots of respect.

entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.

entries.reason: Dialogue de Dresseur, table vivante du complexe de combat.
